summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.76/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.76 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 29, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 23. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ lower than a week ago, 2¢ lower than a month ago, and 83¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.56) and the highest in Superior ($4.10).
